name: Ed Bannon
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 1A

items.text: Ed Bannon is an appointed Chicago Board of Education member representing District 1A on the Far Northwest Side. He served as executive director of the Six Corners Association. A Dunning resident for more than 20 years, he has served on the Dever Elementary Local School Council since 2015, where he is secretary and has chaired the principal selection committee.

sentences.text: Ed Bannon is an appointed Chicago Board of Education member representing District 1A on the Far Northwest Side.
He served as executive director of the Six Corners Association.
A Dunning resident for more than 20 years, he has served on the Dever Elementary Local School Council since 2015, where he is secretary and has chaired the principal selection committee.

items.text: On the school board, he voted for the district budget plan. He says a top goal is increasing public education funding without raising property taxes. He hosted a public budget briefing to explain district finances and hear from residents. He reached out to a board member with an opposing view to discuss collaborating.
